description:
CityRise are delighted to present this well-appointed one-bedroom apartment located within the Vernon Court development in Northampton.

The property features a modern open-plan layout, bringing together the living, dining, and kitchen areas to create a bright and functional living space. The well-proportioned double bedroom is complemented by a contemporary bathroom.

Ideally positioned, Vernon Court benefits from convenient access to Northampton town centre, a wide range of local amenities, and excellent transport links, including Northampton railway station and key road connections. This highly desirable location, combined with consistent rental demand in the area, makes the apartment an attractive opportunity for investors seeking reliable returns.

For further information, including pricing and investment details, please contact our team today.

Ref No: 10017
